Title: 2021-06-21 Hotfix Patch
Subtitle: Hotfix
CleanedNotes:
=== Battlegrounds: Towers of Doom ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing the Waygate Entrance on Towers of Doom to be hit by area of effect and skillshot Abilities.

=== Heroes: Muradin ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] The tooltip for Muradin's Sledgehammer no longer mentions extra stacks for It's Hammer Time.

=== Heroes: Stukov ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Stukov's Fetid Touch now has sounds and animations previously used by Spine Launcher.
  • [Undocumented] Stukov's It Hungers now resets its counter when Lurking Arm is cast.
  • [Undocumented] Stukov's Reactive Ballistospores cooldown is no longer increased by the number of seconds equal to your Death Timer.
  • [Undocumented] Stukov's Bio-Kill Switch now has a 0.0625 second cooldown between uses.
